events.title: Parliament passes further amendments easing citizenship by investment (54 votes)
events.description: Amendments to the identity documents law and the citizenship law, including late amendments that made the names of investor citizens secret, became law after the final vote of 31 May 2018 with 54 deputies in favour.

events.title: First four-month moratorium takes effect
